description: Run the official Khronos gltf-validator against a GLB URL. Returns errors, warnings, infos, and hints with codes + JSON pointers, plus structural counts (animations, materials, etc.) per the validator's info report. The same engine that powers gltf.report.

maxIssues.description: Cap on issues returned in each bucket (default 100). Validator may still scan all of them.

url.description: Public URL or data: URL of a .glb / .gltf file to validate.

name: validate_glb
title: Validate a GLB / glTF against the Khronos spec
